QUOTE: The routing is capability-gated, so a `.sh` file resolves to no grammar. It is registered and searchable, with no symbols... The not-indexed report is stamped at build time. It says, for example, that 14 `.sh` files were in scope and none are in the index.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the build degrades without error when grammars are missing, routing is capability-gated, and the unindexed file types are reported as not indexed.
